question: In loop stories, building up knowledge and experience using loops is a staple, but supposing Subaru was to use this method, roughly how strong could he become? Assuming Reinhard would be impossible, would he be able to defeat Wilhelm?
answer: He wouldn’t get stronger at all. When he ‘Returns by Death’, Subaru’s body doesn’t accumulate any experience. It’s a complete reset. ‘Remember by Death’ is possible, but in terms of becoming stronger, it has no effect at all.
